cohort: 38 postpartum primiparous mothers with a singleton baby
finding: There was no significant difference in inter-rectus distance (IRD) at rest between women who had a vaginal delivery and those who had a cesarean section, but abdominal crunch exercises reduced IRD while drawing-in exercises did not.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in inter-rectus distance (IRD) at rest between women who had a vaginal delivery and those who had a cesarean section.
